sources.title: bert2BERT: Towards Reusable Pretrained Language Models
sources.snippet: In recent years, researchers tend to pre-train ever-larger language models to explore the upper limit of deep models. However, large language model pre-training costs intensive computational resources and most of the models are trained from scratch without reusing the existing pre-trained models, which is wasteful.
